User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user within the TaskZen application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user entity.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile photo.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

Task.title: Task
Task.description: Represents a task within the TaskZen application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the task entity.

description.description: A detailed description of the task.

status.description: The current status of the task (e.g., todo, in-progress, done).

priority.description: The priority level of the task (e.g., low, medium, high).

dueDate.description: The date when the task is due.

assignedTo.description: Reference to User. (Relationship: User 1:N Task) The ID of the user assigned to the task.

createdBy.description: Reference to User. (Relationship: User 1:N Task) The ID of the user who created the task.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the task was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the task was last updated.

parentTaskId.description: The ID of the parent task, if this is a sub-task.

Comment.title: Comment
Comment.description: Represents a comment on a task within the TaskZen application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the comment entity.

taskId.description: Reference to Task. (Relationship: Task 1:N Comment) The ID of the task the comment belongs to.

userId.description: Reference to User. (Relationship: User 1:N Comment) The ID of the user who created the comment.

userName.description: The name of the user who created the comment.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the comment was created.
